title: Extreme poverty (number), 1820-2015
claim_summary: The number of people in extreme poverty fell even as the number not in extreme poverty rose rapidly.
book_citation: Our World in Data, Roser & Ortiz-Ospina 2017, based on data from Bourguignon & Morrison 2002 (1820-1992) and the World Bank 2016g (1981-2015).
notes: Book-period source family and visual encoding are reproduced; no comparable post-2015 extension is plotted.
